verdict: Organic presence is active but visibility dropped sharply this week.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — the last 28 days were driven entirely by organic and Google Business Profile activity, with no paid spend on any channel. GBP engagement declined meaningfully in the final week, with actions down 50%, 30%, and 37% respectively versus the prior seven days, and search clicks followed a parallel downward trend across all brands. The most likely driver is a visibility or indexing issue that is currently under investigation, with a web and SEO root-cause fix now in motion. Two O'Hare Precision profiles are also being corrected for a missing or broken call button that suppressed inbound calls despite active impressions. As the SEO work resolves and CRM pipeline blockers are cleared, organic engagement should stabilize and outreach sequences will be ready to launch.

watch_item.issue: GBP actions and search clicks fell sharply across all three brands in the last seven days, with three consecutive zero-action days confirmed at Forte Metals — a signal that points to a search visibility or indexing event.
watch_item.fix: A web and SEO root-cause review is underway now, with site reindexing targeted for completion by end of October; two O'Hare Precision profiles are also being corrected to restore call functionality.
